# Acme Corp

We build the analytics platform that enterprise teams actually use.

## Product

Acme's platform connects to your existing data sources and surfaces insights your team can act on — without a data science team.

## Company

Founded in 2021. 30 employees. Backed by Sequoia and Y Combinator (W22).

We raised a $12M Series A in March 2024 led by Sequoia Capital.
